purpose: Test compact functions fitted on activation manifolds in a simpler native architecture before returning to hybrid Qwen. This does not establish 128B-to-9B feasibility.
primary_teacher: local SmolLM2-1.7B-Instruct, LlamaForCausalLM; not Meta Llama weights
replication: Qwen3.5 hybrid later; differences in tokenizer/training prevent causal architecture attribution.
parameter_axis: Non-embedding transformer parameters; vocab tables excluded from the experiment.
stages: H0a: shape-only accounting and reviewed protocol.
H0b: isolated native MLP input-code to output-code fits at early/mid/late sites, PCA and learned charts against restricted-weight baseline and full-state control.
H0c: separately activated composition of adjacent native blocks including attention, preserving sequence/KV conditioning.
controls: Freeze reconstruction-anchored charts before fitting native maps.
Measure downstream teacher KL on common outputs; code-space MSE only within chart.
Normalized wide-space update error uses identity=1 baseline.
Report training/collection/chart/target costs as well as inference parameters.
Inference must carry compact states directly; wide decoder/teacher continuation permitted only as labelled diagnostic.
budget_proposal: Two non-embedding whole-stack proxy budgets around 2.5x and 8x; 14.2x accounting reference, no width selected yet.
decision_proposal: Exploratory learned-chart primary at the aggressive budget: paired document bootstrap CI of KL_new - 0.75 * KL_baseline; require upper 95% < 0 and a copy-tail guard, at two of three prespecified sites. Exact data, resource, tail and budget rules remain unfrozen.
open_before_freeze: Exact corpus provenance, document-group splits, contexts and collection, storage and runtime caps.
Exact k/m and head layout; the native attention port must be audited for correctness.
Charts used offline versus resident deployment costs must be explicit.
An improving data curve means budget-inconclusive when the required criterion is not met; a clear gain need not be rejected for still improving.
Hard copy-tail failures, near-zero KL baseline handling and gate interpretations.
Signed exact code and protocol, plus meaningful synthetic tests.
execution: G1 continues unchanged. No H0 model forward before G1 stops and both agents acknowledge a frozen protocol. This design does not authorize a paid resource.

bottleneck_audit.status: Confirmed by both agents in paird 254 and subsequent Codex review.
bottleneck_audit.finding: Historical warp reconstruction consumed an exact k-wide PCA channel plus a learned k-wide code. It did not enforce a single k-dimensional bottleneck. This confounds equal-width comparisons; it does not prove the entire gain was due to extra width.
bottleneck_audit.requirement: Every H0 learned chart must reconstruct from only its declared k-wide code. No exact PCA bypass or full-state side channel.

shape_scope: These are H0b MLP probe shapes and whole-stack parameter proxies. H0c attention head count/head dimension is not selected. No runtime deployment is claimed.

user_success_paths.goal: Create a useful MoE from a dense teacher using manifold regions.
user_success_paths.comparison: Separately activated branch; compare routing/expert baselines with active computation, total stored parameters and routing overhead reported separately.

user_success_paths.goal: Beat logit distillation on the training budget for a smaller model.
user_success_paths.comparison: Hold architecture and initialization fixed for the supervision comparison; count teacher collection, chart fitting, block fitting and final healing. Separate initialization ablations from loss-function claims.

user_success_paths.goal: Produce stronger task performance than comparable-size public models.
user_success_paths.comparison: Use a frozen evaluation suite and report post-healing quality. Public models are quality references, not controls for unknown pretraining cost.

user_success_paths.goal: Provide an initialization that reduces subsequent pretraining cost.
user_success_paths.comparison: Compare full learning curves at matched total compute. A weak unhealed output does not rule out a useful starting point.

user_success_paths.goal: Project a small model into a larger architecture.
user_success_paths.comparison: Later growth branch, compared against function-preserving growth and ordinary initialization; no activation under H0.
Separate same-coordinate algebraic combinations from learned cross-model alignment; evaluate after matched healing with host-model regression checks.

user_success_paths.goal: Project selected pieces of a large model into a smaller host.
user_success_paths.comparison: Use a fixed host and matched-size adapter/stitch baseline; shared tokenizer does not establish hidden-state alignment.

user_success_paths.goal: Create a small domain expert from domain-specific activation measurements.
user_success_paths.comparison: Measure in-domain quality versus a domain-distilled or domain-fine-tuned baseline at matched domain exposure and total compute. Report out-of-domain tradeoffs without requiring degradation. Lower task-relevant dimension is a hypothesis to test.

healing_policy: Healing is permitted. Main practical comparisons use post-healing outcomes and full cost accounting; pre-healing metrics remain diagnostics. H0 failure at a chosen representation or budget is not a universal rejection of these success paths.
scope_control: Preserve useful domain groups in collection, but MoE, domain specialization, stitching and growth remain separately agreed branches. They are not silently added to the primary H0 comparison.
